title: After a suitable admissible blowup a finite type map that is an isomorphism over a dense open becomes an open immersion of the strict transform
author: The Stacks Project Authors
work: Stacks Project, chapter spaces-more-morphisms.tex (More on Morphisms of Spaces)
source_version: Stacks Project source tree, file spaces-more-morphisms.tex, corpus local snapshot 20261011
difficulty_reason: For a finite type morphism f : X -> B of algebraic spaces over S that restricts to an isomorphism over a quasi-compact open U of a qcqs base B, the lemma produces a U-admissible blowup B' -> B such that U stays scheme-theoretically dense in B' and the strict transform X' maps isomorphically onto an open subspace of B'. The retained proof is written: proceed in stages using that composites of admissible blowups are admissible (Divisors on Spaces, lemma-composition-admissible-blowups); first blow up the ideal defining B \ U so the complement becomes an effective Cartier divisor (Divisors on Spaces, lemma-blowing-up-gives-effective-Cartier-divisor), which makes U scheme-theoretically dense (lemma-complement-effective-Cartier-divisor); then apply the flattening-by-blowups lemma of the chapter (lemma-flat-after-blowing-up) to make the strict transform flat of finite presentation while preserving density; finally the chapter's Zariski-main-type lemma (lemma-zariski) turns a flat finitely presented monomorphism that is an isomorphism over a scheme-theoretically dense open into an open immersion. Retained author proof at lines 8976-8997.
